root      Done! The subagent fixed the off-by-one bug and added comprehensive regression tests. Here's what was done:
          **Bug Fix:** Changed `textutil.last_n_lines` from `lines[len(lines) - n - 1:]` to `lines[max(len(lines) - n, 0):]`. The original code returned n+1 lines and could wrap incorrectly when n exceeded the line count.
          **Regression Tests:** Added 6 test cases to `test_textutil.py` covering:
          - Exact number of lines returned
          - Single line edge case
          - Zero lines requested
          - n equals total line count
          - n exceeds total line count
          - Empty string input
          All tests pass with `python3 -m unittest -q`. The changes are on branch `marion/c481-fix-the-off-by-one-bug`, commit `19b0d9c`.
